SEUS_POSTS.TITLE: Your posts
SEUS_POSTS.SUBTITLE: See how your posts are doing.
SEUS_POSTS.RANGE: Last {days} days · Meta numbers can take up to 2 days

HEADLINE.instagram: Your Instagram was seen {count} times without ads.
HEADLINE.facebook: Your Page was seen {count} times without ads.
HEADLINE.ZERO: Your posts were not seen in the last {days} days.

ACCOUNT_NOTE.instagram: Also counts stories and older posts seen in the period.
ACCOUNT_NOTE.facebook: Also counts videos and older posts seen in the period.

HEADLINE.NO_NUMBER: Meta has not sent the views for the last {days} days yet.

CHANGE.FIRST_PERIOD: First period with numbers: nothing to compare yet.

VIEWS.LABEL: Times seen
VIEWS.HELP: the same person can see it more than once.

PEOPLE.LABEL: People who saw
PEOPLE.HELP_instagram: at most this number. Someone who saw a post and a story can count twice.
PEOPLE.HELP_facebook: each person counts once, even after seeing several posts.

INTERACTIONS.LABEL: Interactions
INTERACTIONS.HELP_instagram: likes, comments, saves and shares, across all posts and stories.

FOLLOWERS.LABEL: Followers
FOLLOWERS.FEW: At {min} followers I show who started following

MESSAGES.LABEL: Messages
MESSAGES.HELP: conversations started in this profile's inbox in the period.

TILES.TITLE: Compared with the previous {days} days
TILES.LEGEND: May include ads: {names}. The rest is without ads.

POSTS.TITLE: Posts from the last {days} days
POSTS.EMPTY_PERIOD: You did not post in the last {days} days.
POSTS.EMPTY_PERIOD_TEXT: Pick a longer period to find your posts.

EMPTY_POST.instagram: Post on Instagram and come back to see how it went.
EMPTY_POST.facebook: Post on your Page and come back to see how it went.

POSTS.TRUNCATED: You posted a lot in this period: showing the 300 most recent posts.

UNAVAILABLE.TITLE: Meta did not send your posts right now.
UNAVAILABLE.TEXT: The numbers above still hold. Try again in a moment.

POSTS.STALE: Meta did not send the posts right now: these are from the last reading.

CARD.PUBLISHED_NO_INSIGHTS: Posted on {date} · likes and comments only

NO_INBOX.TITLE: Connect your Instagram to see how your posts are doing.
NO_INBOX.TEXT: Once connected, I show here how each post went.
NO_INBOX.ASK_ADMIN: Ask the account administrator to connect Instagram or the Facebook Page.
NO_INBOX.PAGE: Using a Facebook Page? Connect the Page

NO_PERMISSION.TEXT_instagram: Instagram asks for your permission once. Then you come back to this page.
NO_PERMISSION.TEXT_facebook: Facebook asks for your permission once. Then you come back to this page.
NO_PERMISSION.ASK_ADMIN: Ask the account administrator to allow this profile's numbers.
NO_PERMISSION.ERROR: Could not open the authorization. Try again.

NO_ACCESS.TITLE: Your role does not open Your posts.
NO_ACCESS.TEXT: Ask the account administrator to add Your posts to your role.

ERROR.TITLE: Could not load your posts.
ERROR.TEXT: Check your connection and try again.

UNAVAILABLE.TITLE: Meta did not answer right now.
UNAVAILABLE.TEXT: This profile's numbers come back as soon as Meta answers.

SEUS_POSTS.STALE: Meta did not answer right now: these are the numbers from the last reading.
